item.description: The camera holds a close-medium oblique view of the exterior corner of a completed single-storey or low-rise brick building (`ent_wall`) set beside unpaved earth and green trees on the left. The brickwork shows alternating rectangular stretcher and narrower header faces painted or washed in a uniform light terracotta-pink colour, with neat recessed mortar joints and a stone or rubble plinth visible at the very bottom left base at 0.0s. To the right of the corner is a deep red-painted brick arch framing a decorative panel (`ent_arch_feature`) embedded with green and dark glass bottles arranged radially at the top and vertically below. Across 0.0s to 6.250667s, the camera slowly tilts upward and drifts slightly leftward, causing the bottom plinth and lower bottle row to exit the bottom of the frame while bringing more of the upper stepped red window hoods/eaves on the left wall and upper courses into view. Simultaneously, a vertical grey pole (`ent_left_pole`) enters and widens along the far left edge of the frame from roughly 0.5s onward.
